# Anand Vallamsetla — The Why Man

> Hands-on engineering leader and applied AI architect with 26 years of experience (2000-present) — sets technical direction and writes the code. Built his own multi-agent harness (Exponential OS, exponentialos.io): constitution-enforced engineering principles, agentic memory and context management, control plane with model routing, composable skills and MCP integrations. Ships production agentic systems on it. Brings 10+ years of engineering management including a $40B+ portfolio at Google delivering $500M+ ROI. Most recently Engineer in Residence at AI Fund, Andrew Ng's venture studio (May-Jul 2026).

## Profile

- [Home](https://thewhyman.com/): Senior Engineering Leader · Applied AI Architect · Agentic Systems & LLM Platforms.
- [Meet](https://thewhyman.com/meet): Book a recruiter conversation, consulting session, invited meeting, or introduction. Acceptance criteria and the eval plan are fixed before any code is written.

## Work

- [Build](https://thewhyman.com/build-details): Exponential OS — Multi-Agent Harness (exponentialos.io) — Built his own multi-agent harness: a generative-principle constitution enforcing engineering invariants as structural and semantic gates before any output ships.
- [Invent](https://thewhyman.com/invent-details): Exponential OS — a multi-agent harness built from zero — Built his own agentic runtime rather than adopting a framework: constitution-enforced engineering principles, an agentic memory layer for context management, a control plane for routing and model selection, composable skills and MCP integrations.
- [Lead](https://thewhyman.com/lead-details): AI Fund — product discovery to delivery — Owned the full loop across two major pivots: customer discovery, ICP selection, contextual inquiry and Mom Test interviews, with demand validated before any build was scaled.
